Analyze entitlement data against active installations to identify compliance gaps, financial exposure, or over-licensing. Compile technical data, reports, and documentation needed to support lead SAMs during formal vendor software audits. Normalize, and match raw software discovery data from tools Jamf, SCCM, Intune, Aternity). Resolve data discrepancies between discovery feeds, procurement repositories, and user directories to maintain asset record integrity. Update and maintain accurate software catalog entries, publisher names, and stock-keeping units (SKUs) in the SAM repository. Policy, Standard & Procedure Documentation Write, update, and maintain detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process maps, and operational guidelines for software management.
